desc: GTK application for transferring files over Bluetooth
doc: bluetooth-sendto - GTK application for transferring files over Bluetooth
bluetooth-sendto will display a dialog for transferring files over Bluetooth. bluetooth-sendto is part of gnome-bluetooth, see also http://live.gnome.org/GnomeBluetooth

<dl><dt data-o="">--device</dt><dd>Define the device address to send the file(s) to. If omitted a chooser will be displayed.</dd><dt data-o="">--name</dt><dd>Define the device name to send the file(s) to. If omitted it will be auto detected.</dd><dt>file</dt><dd>The file(s) to send to the device. If omitted a chooser will be displayed.</dd></dl>
